name: No rugs: the staged room with the bed as its anchor, washable bedding and cushions, no canopy
notes:
Rug-free alternative (F-66): the staged arrangement (a) kept piece for piece, without the VALLABY rug and the LÖVA canopy, for a family that may skip rugs for dust and dust mites. 11 placed, 9 extras.
What replaced the rug: nothing on the floor. The play floor between the TROFAST and the desk stays bare and wipes clean, and her two SKOGSDUVA flower cushions (machine-washable at 40 °C) are her seats there. The GREJSIMOJS mat does not fit open: it is 47 1/4" square, and the free floor between the TROFAST's boxes (x 57.9) and the heater's 12" for textiles (x 100, F-33) is 42 1/8" wide, with the door's and the closet's 36" landings below it (F-31). It folds up into a toy box, but its page gives no folded size, so it is not drawn here (F-11); it is staged open in the living room's e. No plastic-free mat fits either (Andrew, 2026-10-25: "something that isn't literally plastic"): her play floor is 48 x 30" for a mat that isn't a textile (6" off the heater's face), and the cork mats on natural rubber come 72 to 80" long; the foam mats that would fit are plastic.
F-66 moves: (1) the bed as the anchor: the MINNEN on the left wall, the GODISHUS beside its head as the bedside table and the TROFAST along its foot, her reading nook; (2) light: the UPPLYST cloud above the headboard, where the canopy hung, the TÖVÄDER cat night light on the GODISHUS, and the ceiling light, which marks the play floor if it is central as most are (its place isn't recorded), with no floor lamp on the play floor, which a 4-year-old would knock over; (3) no wall anchor over the bed, on purpose: nothing hangs over a 4-year-old's bed that she could pull down (the BLODFLÄDER's own note), so the cloud lamp crowns the headboard and the BLODFLÄDER two birds (canvas, no glass) hangs at her eye level at the bed's foot; (4) color off the floor in washable textiles: the BARNDRÖM flower bedding (cover and fitted sheet, machine wash at 140°F/60°C, hot enough to kill dust mites), the SMÅSPORRE insert (also 140°F/60°C) and the SKOGSDUVA cushions, with the green of the FLISAT desk and the FEJKA; (5) the FEJKA on the GODISHUS (artificial: wipe it); (6) no mat (above), the one F-66 move this room can't make. The LÖVA canopy is left out: it gathers dust and washes only by hand.
bed-1 MINNEN (fully extended, 77.5"), head on the top wall, long side on the left wall, flush (IKEA: under 2 1/2" or over 9" from a wall): F-34 open side clear for 32.5" between the dresser and the TROFAST and 41" out to the desk chair, but the way into that space passes between the desk's front-left corner (67.75, 25.6) and the TROFAST's top corner (57.9, 49.4): 25.7" on the diagonal (walkway-narrow:25.7, F-30; it was 18.2" until the final audit 2026-10-26 moved the TROFAST 8.5" toward the foot, and 30" can't be had with the dresser and the TROFAST both on this side); the TROFAST runs along the lower 28" of its side and 8.5" past its foot; F-33 bedding 71.5" from the heater face.
dresser-1 GODISHUS 3-drawer beside the bed's head as the bedside table (23 5/8" high): F-32 32.5" in front to the TROFAST's end; F-21 anchor it (IKEA: "must be securely anchored").
desk-1 FLISAT on the top wall in the window corner: F-33 right end 6" from the heater face; F-35 30" chair zone clear behind it (y 25.6 to 55.6), the chair 19.5" from the heater, not backed against a heater wall; 3 1/8" from the dresser. chair-1 SUNDVIK pulled out at the desk ("Last chance" at IKEA: buy it with the desk).
cabinet-1 BESTÅ shelf unit with doors, 47 1/4x16 1/2x15" (top): top wall above the desk, x 58.75-106, its right end 6" short of the heater face (F-33): closed storage for markers, paint, glue and rotation toys a parent hands down (F-63): solid LAPPVIKEN doors (no glass, F-21), hung on 2 BESTÅ suspension rails screwed into studs (extras), underside about 54" up. That is above her reach from the floor only: standing on the desk she reaches it, so put a child lock on its push-open doors, or keep only washable, non-toxic supplies in it.
toys-1 TROFAST along the bed's open side, rot 270, x 40.5-57.9, y 49.4-86: its back to the bed rail, its end 8.5" past the bed's foot, the boxes facing the play floor. F-32 54" in front of the boxes to the heater face; F-31 36" from the closet doors, its end on the edge of the closet's and the door's 36" landings without entering them; F-33 54" from the heater face, with no slot beside the heater. 20 1/2" tall with no anchoring warning on its page. Her books stand face out on its top, within reach of the bed. Making the bed means reaching over it at the foot.
lamp-1 UPPLYST cloud (top): moved from the left wall beside the middle of the bed (y 34-46, past her lap when she sits up) to the top wall above the headboard, centered on the bed, x 14.25-26.25: light from over her shoulder when she sits up for a story, and its cord fastened down behind the headboard rather than down the wall beside her. It gives 110 lumens, a glow: a story needs the ceiling light on too, and a brighter wall reading lamp (about 300 to 450 lumens, warm white, cord fastened) is not in the catalog. lamp-2 RÖDFLIK desk lamp (top) at the desk's left end, x 68.5-74.5, is her task light, the window on her right (none before the final audit 2026-10-26); its cord fastened along the top wall to an outlet. nightlight-1 TÖVÄDER (battery, no cord at the bed, timer) and plant-1 FEJKA (artificial) on the dresser. art-1 BLODFLÄDER (canvas, no glass, F-21) on the left wall at the bed's foot, y 70-86.5, its bottom above the 28 3/8" footboard: it clears an open door up to 35.5" wide (at y 74-90.5 it cleared only a 30" door, by 1.5"; the door is unmeasured and can't be taped before the move, Andrew 2026-10-26, F-07: its hinge is at the bottom-left corner, as the sketch's arc shows, and a bedroom door in a 1955 house runs 28" to 32", under the 35.5"; final audit 2026-10-26).
Maddie is 4 (F-21): every piece within her reach is under 27" or anchored (the GODISHUS carries IKEA's anchor warning at 23 5/8", so it is anchored too); no glass anywhere; no loft or bunk. The desk ends 12" from the window wall, beside the window, with the chair as a step up to it: fit window stops or guards on her window before she moves in (assumed-position:window). The heater's type is unknown: if its cover gets hot, guard the 6" slot at the desk's end, where crayons fall.
Walkways (F-30): the 36" landings in front of the door and the closet are open floor (F-31); door to room along them and up past the TROFAST's end, on the landings' edge; bed to desk 41"; into the bed's side 25.7" between the desk's corner and the TROFAST's corner (walkway-narrow:25.7); bed to door around the TROFAST's end.
Extras: VIMSIG mattress and BARNDRÖM fitted sheet in the frame, SMÅSPORRE insert, BARNDRÖM cover, low pillow, SKOGSDUVA cushions x2 (40 °C doesn't kill dust mites; wash them often), BENGTA panel (cut to clear the heater, F-33) on the HUGAD rod (assumed-position:window), BESTÅ suspension rails x2. Not placed: the FLISAT book display ikea-80614566 (as in a), the VALLABY rug and the LÖVA canopy (F-66, above), the GREJSIMOJS (it does not fit open, above).
Total $1,159.32: placed $787.90 + extras $371.42; prices as of 2026-10-22 (price-stale, F-02) except the BESTÅ pieces, read 2026-10-23. Unchanged by the audit. Flags across the layout: assumed-position:door, assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:window, heater-depth-assumed, walkway-narrow:25.7 (the way into the bed's side), delivery-path-unmeasured (the VIMSIG mattress ships flat, F-22).
Audit 2026-10-24: without the rug and canopy it is still a child's room (the flower bedding, the cloud lamp, the cat light, the green desk and the two-birds print carry it), plainer than a, and the bare play floor is the real loss. The UPPLYST moved above the headboard: a crown where the canopy hung, light over her shoulder, its cord behind the headboard. The notes no longer claim a lamp marking the play floor or a wall anchor over the bed. Two safety lines added: window stops, and a lock on the BESTÅ, since the desk is a step up to both.
Final audit 2026-10-26: the way into the bed's open side measured 18.2" between the desk's front-left corner and the TROFAST's top corner, narrower than the 24" it led into (the notes' 41" ran past that corner), so the TROFAST moved 8.5" toward the foot, its end on the landings' edge: the way in is 25.7" and the side 32.5"; the art hangs 4" higher, above the footboard, to clear a door up to 35.5"; a RÖDFLIK at the desk's left end is her task light, with the window on her right; the VIMSIG's delivery flag is listed. The MINNEN's page gives 50 to 77 1/2" (the catalog, read 2026-10-22): re-read it before buying.
